display.purpose: The full name at the top of the home page. Once per page.

subtitle.purpose: The italic role under the name.

title.purpose: Résumé entry titles and project names; weight alone separates them from body.

label.purpose: Italic secondary lines: availability, footer, narrow-screen row labels.

shadows.name: dropdown-lift
shadows.purpose: Only the language menu, the one element that truly floats.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All state transitions, usually at 0.2s; longer (0.4–0.6s) for the project screenshot zoom.

motion.name: status-pulse
motion.purpose: The availability dot. Stopped by prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Résumé Entry

components.css: .ds-entry { font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; color: var(--text); } .ds-entry__head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; column-gap: 24px; } .ds-entry__title { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-strong); line-height: 1.2; } .ds-entry__org { font-weight: 400; } .ds-entry__org a { color: inherit; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--border-strong); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-entry__org a:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-entry__org a:active { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-entry__org a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-entry__date { margin: 0; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-entry__desc { margin: 2px 0 0; color: var(--text-muted); }

components.name: Inline Text Link
components.description: Links inside paragraphs: bright ink over a quiet rule-line underline that fills on hover.
components.html: Take a look into my projects.
components.css: .ds-p { font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--text); line-height: 1.6; } .ds-link { color: var(--text-strong); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--border-strong); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-link:active { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: The only small button style: a hairline-outlined italic label, used for Copy.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; background: none; padding: 1px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-sm); font-size: 0.85rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--text-muted); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s var(--ease-out), color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background-color: var(--surface-hover); color: var(--text-strong); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: The single larger action, e.g. Back to home on the 404 page.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-md); color: var(--text); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s var(--ease-out), border-color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background-color: var(--surface-hover); border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 10px 16px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.06); border-radius: 20px; background-color: rgb(22 22 22 / 0.6); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav__logo { color: var(--text-strong); } .ds-nav__list { display: flex; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; } .ds-nav__link { display: block; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); color: var(--text-strong); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-nav__link:hover { background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.08); } .ds-nav__link:active { background-color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.12); } .ds-nav__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }

components.name: Contact List
components.description: A definition list set as a hairline-ruled table of channels.
components.css: .ds-contact { margin: 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-contact__row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 8rem 1fr; column-gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; padding: 12px 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); } .ds-contact__row dt { font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-strong); } .ds-contact__row dd { margin: 0; } .ds-contact__link { color: var(--text); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: var(--border-strong); text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease-out), text-decoration-color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-contact__link:hover { color: var(--text-strong); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-contact__link:active { color: var(--text-muted); } .ds-contact__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-contact__arrow { display: inline-block; color: var(--text-subtle); transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease-out), color 0.2s var(--ease-out); } .ds-contact__link:hover .ds-contact__arrow { color: currentColor; transform: translate(2px, -2px); }

components.css: .ds-skill { display: inline-flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 112px; padding: 18px 6px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-md); font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; text-align: center; transition: background-color 0.25s var(--ease-out), border-color 0.25s var(--ease-out); } .ds-skill__icon { width: 26px; height: 26px; color: var(--text-strong); opacity: 0.85; transition: color 0.3s var(--ease-out), opacity 0.3s var(--ease-out); } .ds-skill__name { font-size: 0.85rem; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--text-muted); transition: color 0.25s var(--ease-out); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-skill:hover .ds-skill__icon { color: var(--brand); opacity: 1; } .ds-skill:hover .ds-skill__name { color: var(--text); } }

components.name: Availability Status
components.description: The only green on the site: a pulsing dot beside an italic label.
components.html: Available for work
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; font-family: AtkinsonHyperlegible, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; font-style: italic; color: var(--text-muted); text-decoration: none; } .ds-status:hover { color: var(--text-strong); } .ds-status:active { color: var(--text); } .ds-status:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--text-strong); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); } .ds-status__dot { width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background-color: var(--status); animation: ds-pulse 1800ms infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--status); } 75% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 6px transparent; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status__dot { animation: none; } }

keyCharacteristics: A single reading column in résumé order: name, contact, entries, sections.
Monochrome warm ink on near-black, with five steps of ink brightness carrying all the hierarchy.
Bold titles, italic organizations and stacks, dates right-aligned with tabular numerals.
One typeface (Atkinson Hyperlegible) in four styles, no display face.
Flat surfaces separated by hairlines, not cards or shadows.
Underlines and brightness as the interaction language.

rules.name: The Ink-Only Rule
rules.body: Emphasis is made with weight, italics or brighter ink, never with a hue. If something needs to stand out, make it bolder or brighter.

rules.name: The One Green Dot Rule
rules.body: Available Green marks availability and nothing else. Don't reuse it for success states, links or tags.

rules.name: The Résumé Entry Rule
rules.body: Every dated item is set the same way: **bold title**, *italic organization*, date at the far right with tabular numerals, then the description in Faded Ink. Experience, Awards and future Education entries all share it.

rules.name: The Italic Means Context Rule
rules.body: Italics carry secondary context (the role, organizations, tech stacks, the footer), never emphasis. For emphasis use bold or Bright Ink.

rules.name: The Flat Page Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow except things that truly float (the dropdown). Separate content with hairlines and space.

dos: **Do** set every dated item as a Résumé Entry: bold title, italic organization, date on the right.
**Do** use the color tokens on `:root` (`--text-strong`, `--text`, `--text-muted`, `--text-subtle`, `--surface`, `--border`, …) instead of literal colors.
**Do** give every interactive element a hover state, an `:active` state and the global focus ring (2px Bright Ink outline, 3px offset).
**Do** keep every link and button at least 44px tall on touch screens (`--tap`).
**Do** use `--ease-out` (`cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)`) at around 0.2s for state changes, and respect the `prefers-reduced-motion` rule.
**Do** keep every user-facing string in the translation files, in both English and Spanish.
donts: **Don't** introduce an accent hue. Emphasis is brighter ink or bold weight.
**Don't** use Available Green for anything except the availability dot.
**Don't** put content in cards with shadows; separate content with hairlines and space.
**Don't** add a second typeface or a display face.
**Don't** put a small uppercase label or kicker above a section heading; the heading stands alone.
**Don't** use italics for emphasis; italics mean secondary context.
